ai-chat.heading: Choose an assistant around your actual task
ai-chat.intro: For writing, research or coding support, compare the exact app plan, account eligibility and tool access. A familiar model name does not prove which features are included in a seller-listed package.
checks: Try the same non-sensitive task and verify factual answers yourself.
Ask about message limits, file handling, reset periods and account control.
Keep consumer subscriptions separate from developer API billing.

video.heading: Compare output requirements before credit counts
video.intro: Video generation, editing and voice services charge for different units. Define the length, resolution, voice permissions and export formats you need before comparing packages.
checks: Ask how revisions, failed generations and quality settings affect usage.
Confirm credit expiry, queue limits and the exact included app.
Check permission for uploaded voices, music and client content.

design.heading: Check workspace control and design rights
design.intro: Design subscriptions can differ in editing seats, asset libraries, export formats and workspace permissions. A low starting price may describe an access arrangement that does not suit independent client work.
checks: Identify the exact product, edition and editing permissions.
Ask who administers the workspace and can access your designs.
Check asset licensing and any Education eligibility requirements.

writing.heading: Choose writing support for your workflow
writing.intro: Compare the languages, document formats and editing tasks you actually use. A subscription is not a guarantee of original, accurate or publication-ready output; review the work and verify sources.
checks: Confirm word, document or generation limits and their reset period.
Check export formats and integrations before selecting a longer term.
Avoid uploading confidential drafts before reviewing the provider's data terms.

coding.heading: Separate developer seats from usage budgets
coding.intro: Coding assistants, app builders and automation tools solve different problems. Define whether you need an editor, deployment, workflow execution or a model API, then check the exact seller package.
checks: Ask whether model usage, hosting and execution quotas are separate charges.
Review repository permissions and keep keys out of chat and source control.
Test changes on a small project and review generated code before release.

productivity.heading: Match permissions to your working group
productivity.intro: Productivity offers may describe a personal plan, organisation seat or a specialist business product. Compare storage, collaboration permissions and the ability to export your work before choosing by duration alone.
checks: Identify who owns the workspace and who can remove access.
Confirm guest, member and administrator permissions for your tasks.
Ask what happens to documents and shared links when the plan ends.

security.heading: Review privacy features and device terms separately
security.intro: Security subscriptions are not interchangeable. Establish the exact service tier, supported devices, renewal terms and legitimate account access; a paid plan does not guarantee anonymity or protection against every threat.
checks: Ask which VPN, security or identity features the package actually includes.
Confirm device and simultaneous-connection restrictions for your use.
Read the provider's privacy terms before sending sensitive traffic.

entertainment.heading: Confirm household, region and profile rules
entertainment.intro: Streaming subscriptions differ in household eligibility, geographic availability, devices and quality. A seller's duration or profile label does not override the streaming provider's membership terms.
checks: Check whether the exact account arrangement is permitted for you.
Confirm regional availability, supported devices and simultaneous use.
Separate access duration from warranty and avoid relying on promised permanent access.

software.heading: Verify the license as well as the edition
software.intro: A software key, subscription and digital entitlement are different things. Confirm the edition, device requirements and legitimate license basis rather than treating successful activation as proof of every usage right.
checks: Ask about device count, transfer restrictions and the license channel.
Check compatibility and whether renewal or an existing qualifying license is required.
Obtain the agreed package and seller warranty in writing before payment.

amazon-fba.heading: Compare research access, not promised sales
amazon-fba.intro: Amazon seller tools can have different marketplace coverage, research modules and daily allowances. Choose the data and workflows you need; a research subscription does not guarantee rankings, product demand or revenue.
checks: List the specific keyword and product-research modules required.
Check exclusions, history depth and usage limits in the exact package.
Confirm legitimate delivery and whether connecting a seller account is necessary.

ai-image-generation.heading: Check generation mode, privacy and output rights
ai-image-generation.intro: Image plans can differ in processing time, generation modes and visibility. A private access label is not the same as a provider's private-generation feature; ask about both separately.
checks: Confirm the actual tier, generation allowance and queue behaviour.
Ask whether outputs are publicly visible and which privacy features apply.
Review commercial-use conditions and rights in uploaded reference material.

creative-resources.heading: Keep asset licensing with each project
creative-resources.intro: Stock media, fonts and templates require attention to the intended end use. Library access does not establish unrestricted redistribution rights or automatically provide a license for every client project.
checks: Check whether the project needs a separate registration or license record.
Clarify client delivery, template resale and source-file restrictions.
Establish how the license is obtained legitimately and what expiry changes.

youtube-seo.heading: Use creator tools as research aids
youtube-seo.intro: YouTube research tools can help organise keyword ideas and content planning. Their estimates and recommendations do not guarantee views, subscribers, monetisation or search rankings.
checks: Check channel count, research allowances and the exact tier.
Review required channel permissions and connect accounts only through a legitimate provider flow.
Measure results against your own channel data instead of treating a tool score as a promise.
